Sidebar.css row padding 0.45em/0.35em gap (was 1.3em gap applied twice), filter bar has darken-2 class with a white input (rgb(255,255,255)), footer is one row (0.35em padding) with a gear + two-circle anonymous avatar, both in a shared 1.9em square. Screenshots at http://localhost/framework/ match. Agrees with audit: done.

But ai/v/3/page.js was built LATER (mtime 17:15) as a separate board, has no --size usage anywhere (grepped), uses its own unrelated card-width slider instead, and my own screenshot of /framework/ai/v/3/ at 1920px shows a bare top gutter and a ~700px empty right column. The connected live tab was actually sitting on /framework/ai/v/3/... -- v3, not v2, is what is in front of the owner. Verdict: differs.

whisper-local: confirmed. whisper-server answers 200/health on 127.0.0.1:8178 right now (PID 35172). ux/Dictate/Dictate.js re-sends the growing clip to whisper every 1.5s (resend_ms) and shows it grey as a partial -- its own page.js:58 is honest that this is a faked live, not true streaming, since whisper.cpp itself does not stream. ext/Ask/reply.js:5,173 now imports and builds on ux/Dictate, replacing the old silent mic.js. background-layer: confirmed live at /framework/ui/background/ -- background(kind) div, ten kinds (ground/gradient/dots/grid/stripes/texture/scatter/blobs/wave/spotlight), no images, screenshot shows real dot/grid/stripe patterns rendering. sidebar-designs: confirmed not. No public/framework/ai/2026-09-19/sidebar-designs/ dir exists, no reference anywhere except the audit row and the 2026-09-17 chat log. Agrees with audit: not.

Fence slip, self-caught: ran the new-task skill's usage-refresh step before rereading my own brief's fence, which does NOT list ai/usage.json as mine to touch. It overwrote public/framework/ai/usage.json (git shows it untracked/unchanged, low risk) but I should not have. Skipped the usage.jsonl append entirely and made no further writes outside verify-design/**, day.jsonl and page.js's one children line from here on.

Found and fixed a real bug in my own page.js while proving it live: a({href: url}, "text") does not set href in this framework (it creates a nested named-child slot instead), so my first draft rendered links as doubled text like /framework/ai/v/2/ai/v/2/. Fixed to a(text).href(url) everywhere, re-shot, confirmed correct. Logged one line in .claude/skills/code/improvements.md since a sibling task (verify-server) used the same wrong pattern.

assign.outcome:
**Five of the six design-system/sidebar rows hold up under a second, harder look. The sixth (run-page-compact) is graded `done` but really `differs`: the real fix landed on a board the owner has since stopped using.**

[The report](/framework/ai/2026-09-19/verify-design/) — [verify.jsonl, all six rows with evidence](/framework/ai/2026-09-19/verify-design/verify.jsonl)

`ai/v/2/` genuinely ships the Compact/Cozy/Roomy switch on the design system's own `--size` classes, exactly as asked. But `ai/v/3/` was built two hours later, never picked up that switch, uses its own unrelated width slider, and my own fresh screenshot shows it wasting the same top/side space the owner complained about — and the one browser tab already connected to this dev server, before I touched anything, was sitting on v3, not v2.

The other five agree with the earlier audit, each re-checked against the live site or the real code, not the audit's word: sidebar rows/filter/footer genuinely fixed (read Sidebar.css, saw it live); whisper-local's server answers live right now and the dictation UI really shows growing partial text; the popover system's two placements were built and compared on camera, the winner running the AI page's picker; the background layer's ten kinds render live (just not linked from /framework/ui/'s own overview page yet); sidebar-designs is still simply not started.

Left: whether to point v3 at v2's --size switch, or tell the owner v2 is the one to use, is the owner's call, not mine to make.
